channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Pinterest forecasts upbeat quarterly revenue on resilient advertiser spending
item.description: Pinterest forecasts upbeat quarterly revenue due to resilient advertiser spending. The company expects a positive outlook for the quarter. Pinterest forecasts upbeat quarterly revenue on resilient advertiser spending.

item.title: Palantir tops first-quarter revenue estimates on strong US government demand
item.description: Palantir's first-quarter revenue exceeded estimates, driven by strong demand from the US government. The company's revenue growth was fueled by government contracts. Palantir tops first-quarter revenue estimates on strong US government demand.

item.title: Attacks in Gulf Threaten to Reignite Conflict
item.description: US warships shot down missiles and drones targeting ships in the Strait of Hormuz. The United Arab Emirates attributed a drone attack to Iran. U. S. warships shot down missiles and drones aimed at ships the Navy was guiding through the Strait of Hormuz, and the authorities in the United Arab Emirates blamed Iran for a drone attack.

item.title: Russia offers Ukraine May 8-9 ceasefire amid WWII anniversary, but threatens major reprisals in
item.description: Russia proposed a two-day ceasefire in Ukraine on May 8-9, amid World War II anniversary commemorations in Moscow. President Putin declared the truce unilaterally. President Putin has unilaterally declared a two-day truce amid commemorations of the end of World War II in Moscow.

item.title: UAE shoots down Iranian missiles for first time since ceasefire
item.description: The UAE shot down Iranian missiles for the first time since a ceasefire, marking a significant escalation in the region's tensions. Iran latest: UAE shoots down Iranian missiles for first time since ceasefire The Times.

item.title: Iran-US clash over alleged warship attack in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran claims its navy forced a US warship to retreat from the Strait of Hormuz. The US denied any clash occurred between the two navies. Iran claims its navy forced a US warship to turn back from the Strait of Hormuz as Washington denies any clash.

item.title: Zambia delaying US deals over minerals and data demands
item.description: Zambia is delaying US deals over demands for minerals and data, citing concerns over strategic autonomy. The government prefers partnerships over aid and has rejected US funds. Government calls for partnership not aid as it rejects US funds due to strategic autonomy concerns.

item.title: UN accuses Iran of executing dozens, arresting thousands for dissenting
item.description: The UN accused Iran of executing dozens and arresting thousands of people for dissenting. The allegations were made by the UN's fact-checking team. Fact Check Team: UN accuses Iran of executing dozens, arresting thousands for dissenting KATU.

item.title: Mali junta leader names himself defence minister after predecessor killed
item.description: Mali's junta leader appointed himself defence minister after his predecessor, Sadio Camara, was killed. Camara died in a jihadist and separatist forces attack. Former Defence Minister Sadio Camara was killed in a massive offensive by combined jihadist and separatist forces.

item.title: Drone Hits a Moscow High-Rise Days Before a Major Military Parade
item.description: A drone hit a Moscow high-rise, breaching the city's air defenses, days before a major military parade. The incident occurred as Ukraine expands its long-range strikes. Air defenses in the Russian capital were breached as Ukraine expands long-range strikes.

item.title: Europe, Canada pull together in Yerevan in Trump's shadow
item.description: The Canadian Prime Minister said in Yerevan that gatherings like the one with European leaders point to a better way forward, rejecting a "transactional, insular, and brutal world." The statement came as leaders met in the Armenian capital.

item.title: US, Gulf Arab nations draft new UN resolution on Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US and Gulf Arab nations have drafted a new UN resolution on the Strait of Hormuz. The move aims to address security concerns in the region. US, Gulf Arab nations draft new UN resolution on Strait of Hormuz Reuters.

item.title: Putin declares May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark WWII anniversary, Defence Ministry says
item.description: Putin declared a May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark the WWII anniversary. Putin declares May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark WWII anniversary, agencies say Reuters. Putin declares May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark WWII anniversary, Defence Ministry says Reuters.

item.title: 3 Indians Injured In Drone Attack By Iran In UAE's Fujairah
item.description: Three Indians were injured in a drone attack by Iran in the UAE's Fujairah. The emirate's energy infrastructure has been targeted before. This is not the first time Fujairah's energy infrastructure has been targeted.

item.title: Modi’s B.J.P. Wins West Bengal State Election for the First Time
item.description: The B. J. P., led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, won control of West Bengal for the first time in state elections. Its opponents accused the party of cheating. The party of Prime Minister Narendra Modi took control of West Bengal for the first time and made gains around the country.

item.title: US Destroys 6 Iranian Small Boats, Shoots Down Missiles And Drones
item.description: The US launched an operation to free up shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, destroying six Iranian small boats and shooting down missiles and drones. US launches an operation to free up shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Two killed after car hits bystanders in Leipzig driver arrested
item.description: Two people were seriously injured in Leipzig after a car hit bystanders. The driver was arrested. A city spokesperson confirmed the incident. A spokesperson for ⁠the city’s mayor said that two people were seriously injured.

item.title: World Must Hold U.S. Responsible for Making Strait of Hormuz Unsafe
item.description: Iran's government says the US is responsible for making the Strait of Hormuz unsafe. The statement was made in response to US naval activities in the region. Iran: World Must Hold U. S.

item.title: UAE Defence Ministry says four cruise missiles fired from Iran
item.description: Four cruise missiles were fired from Iran at the UAE. Authorities ​in the ‌United Arab Emirates’ Fujairah ​said ⁠on May 4, that a ‌fire broke out ‌at ‌the Fujairah ⁠Oil ⁠Industry Zone following what they ​described ‌as a drone attack originating from ‌Iran.

item.title: UAE Says Iran Has Resumed Attacks Amid Strait Of Hormuz Tensions
item.description: An Iranian drone sparked a fire at a key oil facility in Fujairah. Authorities in Fujairah said an Iranian drone sparked a fire at a key oil facility. UAE Says Iran Has Resumed Attacks Amid Strait Of Hormuz Tensions.
